title: MDN brain descending neurons coordinately activate backward and inhibit forward locomotion.
source_locator: Fig. 8D (Results, 'MDNs persist through metamorphosis and induce backward walking in adults'; Video 5)
quote: We observed light-induced backward walking in 8 of 10 adult flies assayed (Figure 8D; Video 5)
mapping_basis: The paper calls the neurons MDNs and identifies them with the adult moonwalker descending neurons; MDN is a MANC type in type_list.csv (synonym DNp50).
stimulation: 0.28 mW/mm2 red light, 10 s, three trials per fly
sensory_condition: wings clipped, agar ring arena, low transmitted light
other_cell_types: off-target projection not connected to MDN (Fig. 8F, green line)
penetrance: 8 of 10 flies walked backward; all 8 expressed ReaChR in moonwalker-like neurons, the 2 non-responders did not
notes: Intersectional 'immortalization': larval MDN line Split3 (ss01613-GAL4) > UAS-FLP flips out lexAop-FRT-stop-FRT-ReaChR:citrine driven by adult moonwalker line VT044845-lexA. Outcome scored as probability of backward walking within 2 s of light onset (Fig. 8D).

title: MDN brain descending neurons coordinately activate backward and inhibit forward locomotion.
source_locator: Fig. 8H (Results, 'MDNs persist through metamorphosis and induce backward walking in adults')
quote: all grew into adults that showed Chrimson-induced backward walking (n = 20; Figure 8H)
mapping_basis: The paper calls the neurons MDNs, matching adult moonwalker neuron morphology in stained brains; MDN is a MANC type in type_list.csv (synonym DNp50).
other_cell_types: a few additional unidentified neurons varying between brains (Fig. 8I, blue shading; four off-target neurons in the example)
penetrance: probability of backward walking ~1.0 vs ~0.1 in controls (Fig. 8H); all 20 selected flies walked backward
n_flies_note: flies preselected as larvae that crawled backward on Chrimson activation
notes: RU486-inducible hPR:FLP driven by Split1 in L1 larvae immortalizes lexA > lexAop-CsChrimson:mVenus in larval MDNs (immortalization stock lists P[13XLexAop2-IVS-CsChrimson.mVenus]). 5 stained adults all showed MDN expression; only MDNs common to all brains.

title: DeepFly3D, a deep learning-based approach for 3D limb and appendage tracking in tethered, adult Drosophila.
source_locator: Fig. 5B; Figure 5—video 1 legend; Results, '3D pose permits robust unsupervised behavioral classification'
quote: Representative MDN>CsChrimson optogenetically activated backward walking.
mapping_basis: Paper names MDN (MDN-1-Gal4, VT44845-DBD; VT50660-AD); MDN is a MANC type and driver_lines.csv maps MDN-1 to MDN.
stimulation: 617 nm LED aimed at dorsal thorax; 5 s illumination within 9 s epochs, 5 trials per fly
sensory_condition: dark imaging chamber, air-supported spherical treadmill, 850 nm IR illumination
penetrance: described as repeatedly and reliably driven; MDN data occupy a distinct backward-walking region of the 3D joint-angle behavioural map (Fig. 5B)
n_flies_note: 6 flies, 29 trials; controls MDN-GAL4/+ 4 flies, 20 trials
notes: Methods paper (3D pose tracking); legs tracked in 3D from 7 cameras. Results: 'optogenetic stimulation experiments that repeatedly and reliably drove certain behaviors'.

title: DeepFly3D, a deep learning-based approach for 3D limb and appendage tracking in tethered, adult Drosophila.
source_locator: Fig. 5C; Figure 5—video 2 legend; Results, '3D pose permits robust unsupervised behavioral classification'
quote: Representative aDN>CsChrimson optogenetically activated antennal grooming.
mapping_basis: Paper's 'aDN' (Hampel 2015) could be aDN1 (DNg62) or aDN2 (DNfl023); the line used, R76F12-AD; R18C11-DBD, is listed in driver_lines.csv as aDN2 -> DNfl023 (one kit row for the R18C11-x-R76F12 pair lists DNg127, UNMAPPED).
stimulation: 617 nm LED aimed at dorsal thorax; 5 s illumination within 9 s epochs, 5 trials per fly
sensory_condition: dark imaging chamber, air-supported spherical treadmill, 850 nm IR illumination
penetrance: described as repeatedly and reliably driven; aDN data occupy a distinct antennal-grooming region of the behavioural map (Fig. 5C)
n_flies_note: 6 flies, 30 trials; controls aDN-GAL4/+ 4 flies, 23 trials
notes: Antennal grooming coded per convention: front legs (rubbing) yes; other legs not described. Grooming video not available locally.

title: A locomotor neural circuit persists and functions similarly in larvae and adult Drosophila.
source_locator: Fig. 3A-G; Results, 'Pair1 activation arrests forward locomotion in adults'
quote: experimental flies expressing Chrimson in Pair1 neurons showed a near-complete arrest of forward locomotion, an increased probability of pausing
mapping_basis: Pair1 is not in type_list/synonyms/driver_lines; described as a GABAergic SEZ descending neuron (medial SEZ soma, contralateral axon in an extremely lateral tract, mainly innervating T1), insufficient to pick one MANC type.
stimulation: red light, 30 s (pre 30 s / light 30 s / post 30 s), three trials, first trial analysed
sensory_condition: closed loop arena, wings intact, starved 4 h, low transmitted light
other_cell_types: off-target neurons innervating T1-T3 neuropils (variable between flies)
penetrance: pausing probability ~0.85 (ATR) vs ~0.05 (vehicle); described as fully penetrant
notes: Speed dropped from ~18 mm/s to ~0 during light. Time immobile and time in 'small movements' (body part movement without translocation, e.g. grooming, wing movement) both increased (Fig. 3E,G); legs not individually scored. Pair1 maps to no kit type; see notes.md.

title: A locomotor neural circuit persists and functions similarly in larvae and adult Drosophila.
quote: Pair1 activation for 4 s arrests forward locomotion but does not cause paralysis in adults in an open field arena.
mapping_basis: Pair1 is not in type_list/synonyms/driver_lines; described as a GABAergic SEZ descending neuron (medial SEZ soma, contralateral axon in an extremely lateral tract, mainly innervating T1), insufficient to pick one MANC type.
stimulation: red light, 4 s (4 s IR / 4 s red / 4 s IR), repeated three times
sensory_condition: open field circular arena 14.5 cm, three flies per arena, infrared light
other_cell_types: off-target neurons innervating T1-T3 neuropils (variable between flies)
penetrance: pausing probability increased vs vehicle (t-test p < 0.001)
notes: Sex not stated for the open-field assay (closed-loop assay used females). Same line and effector as record 0005, different arena and stimulus duration.
